findings.detail: 'red wings take it 5-3.' (40px in the mockup) has no match in the build
'red wings take it 5-3.' is 28px in the mockup and 58px in the build (2.07x)

briefed: - / at 1440px: The mockup sets 'red wings take it 5-3.' at 40px; the build has nothing like it at a comparable size. Render it where and how the mockup does.
- / at 360px: 'red wings take it 5-3.' is 28px in the mockup and 58px in the build (2.07x). Set it back to 28px.
